meta.title: Detector M-E — Hero #4 Suspense-waterfall + Perf Tracks + prod-capability matrix
notes: Order: hero#4 suspense-waterfall detector FIRST (fully verifiable, mirrors prior detectors), then prod-capability matrix (pure, from detector prodCapable flags), then Perf-Tracks integration (adapter-gated; the real React 19.2 Performance Tracks API is a browser humanGate — the version-gate + swap decision is verifiable here).
humanGates: M-E.2: exercising the real React 19.2+ Performance Tracks API (PROFILING_FLAG_PERFORMANCE_TRACKS_SUPPORT) against a live 19.2 app — the adapter version-gate + swap logic is verified here, the live API is not.

stories.title: M-E.3 — Hero #4 suspense-waterfall detector
acceptanceCriteria: src/inject/detectors/suspense-waterfall.ts conforms to the Detector interface; tracks each Suspense boundary's suspension over a ring buffer of the last 5 commits; flags a boundary that re-suspends >=3 times consecutively.
Emits Issue{ type:'SUSPENSE_WATERFALL', component, suspensionCount, ... } with a 'may be intentional' caveat — 'SUSPENSE_WATERFALL' added additively to IssueType.
test/fixtures/suspense-waterfall/ + a registry-harness test asserting emit after >=3 consecutive suspensions and zero for a single/double suspension.
Registered in detectors/index.ts; confidence declared + added to KNOWN_DETECTORS_DEFAULTS; bench baseline; CHANGELOG. npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and the detector suite passes.

stories.title: M-E.4 — production-mode capability matrix
acceptanceCriteria: A pure buildCapabilityMatrix() derives, per registered detector, its {id, confidence, prodCapable} from the detector metadata — one row per detector.

A unit test asserts the matrix includes every registered detector and that prod-only/dev-only classification matches each detector's prodCapable flag (e.g. hydration-mismatch + stale-closure-async are dev-only).
A generated markdown table is written to a docs artifact (or asserted as a string) for the README capability section.
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and the suite passes. (Panel Settings '(dev only)' badge render = humanGate.)

stories.title: M-E.2 — React 19.2+ Performance Tracks gate (live API = humanGate)
acceptanceCriteria: A pure decision fn selectProfilingStrategy(reactVersion) returns 'performance-tracks' for >=19.2 else 'legacy-hook', so the swap is gated behind adapter version detection.
Unit tests cover the version boundary (19.1 -> legacy, 19.2 -> tracks, 18 -> legacy, unknown -> legacy).
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and the suite passes. NOTE: invoking the real Performance Tracks API on a live 19.2 app is a humanGate.
